observations.reason: consumer bundle explicitly defines newly observed producer head differing from its immutable pin as a staleness decision; current producer head was observed and is 1436 commits ahead of the pinned merge

gaps.missing_field: current bounded producer artifact pins and current-head validation result
gaps.blocking_dependency: re-run consumer validator against observed producer head and exact producer artifacts
gaps.evidence_needed: validator receipt with observed_producer_head=a88d184a73ba2ffeebfc7245f630b72ea3f81bca plus exact artifact blob observations
gaps.falsifier: validator reports CLAIM_BLOCKED, artifact mismatch, malformed bundle, or broadened claim boundary
gaps.next_probe: execute validate_rll_federated_claim_bundle.py --observed-producer-head a88d184a73ba2ffeebfc7245f630b72ea3f81bca --require-current with exact observed artifact blobs
gaps.closure_gate: bounded bundle either re-pinned with evidence or explicitly remains stale/blocked; no claim promotion

gaps.missing_field: revision id and deterministic exported-content digest for the current router state
gaps.evidence_needed: current revision ID plus deterministic export bytes/hash
gaps.falsifier: export or revision points to a different object/state than the observed provider ID
gaps.next_probe: enumerate current Drive revision and hash an exported representation without mutating the document
gaps.closure_gate: provider_id + revision_id + digest + observed_at recorded in receipt

projections.L: consumer pin 8251a7fc… → producer current head a88d184a…; Drive router created 2026-07-25 and modified 2026-08-26
projections.O: llamaRafaelia consumer boundary independently agrees that producer remains authority; RafPolimata independently limits itself to computational orchestration
projections.T: Drive canonical router ↔ Mapa routing checkpoint ↔ RLL producer ↔ llamaRafaelia consumer ↔ RafPolimata execution plan
projections.C: staleness means synchronization debt, not scientific refutation; all claims remain bounded
projections.P: provider IDs, repo/path/blob identities and immutable producer pins are retained append-only

coverage.before: RLL federation identified but current producer drift not quantified
coverage.after: producer identity/head observed; consumer bundle/artifact blob pinned; drift quantified as +1436 commits; orchestration and prompt-layer boundaries blob-bound

uncertainty.after: producer authority identity CLOSED; freshness classified STALE_CONSUMER_CANDIDATE; exact current consumer artifact revalidation remains TOKEN_VAZIO
